items.text: PaySetu's UPI app has 2 million downloads but only 35% of users link a bank account in their first week. How would you improve first-week activation?

facts.text: In PaySetu's onboarding funnel, 48% of users who start bank linking drop off at the SMS verification step.
About 40% of PaySetu users have more than one SIM card, and SMS verification fails when the wrong SIM is selected.
Two leading UPI apps let users explore offers and scan-to-pay demos before linking a bank account.

strategy.frameworkReason: Activation is a funnel problem with one step losing half the users, so finding and fixing the biggest leak comes first.
segments: Users who already use another UPI app
strategy.problem: Users who want to link a bank account fail at SMS verification, mostly because the wrong SIM is picked, and never come back.
metrics: Primary: share of new users who link a bank account within 7 days (35% today)
Guardrail: fraud and failed-transaction rate for newly linked accounts

options.name: Smart SIM detection
options.description: Detect which SIM holds the bank-registered number and preselect it, with a clear retry flow.

options.name: Explore before linking
options.description: Let users browse offers and try a demo payment before asking for bank linking.

options.name: Reminder nudges
options.description: Push and WhatsApp reminders to users who dropped off at verification.

strategy.recommendation: Ship smart SIM detection first because it fixes the biggest leak, then test explore-before-linking with a holdout.
tradeoffs: SIM detection needs extra phone permissions, which some users refuse
Explore-first may delay linking for users who would have linked anyway
assumptions: Most verification failures are wrong-SIM errors, not network errors
A one-point lift in linking is worth more than the engineering cost
outline: Problem and where users drop off

judge: The section recommends one option and explains why, rather than listing ideas without choosing.

name: Critic: a strong, cited section passes

items.text: How would you improve first-week bank-linking activation for PaySetu's UPI app (35% today)?

facts.text: In PaySetu's onboarding funnel, 48% of users who start bank linking drop off at the SMS verification step.
About 40% of PaySetu users have more than one SIM card, and SMS verification fails when the wrong SIM is selected.

markdown:
### Where users drop off
Half of the problem sits in one step: 48% of users who start bank linking drop off at SMS verification [S1]. About 40% of users are on dual-SIM phones, and verification fails when the wrong SIM is picked [S2]. So the biggest lever is not motivation, it is a broken step.

### Who is affected
- **Dual-SIM Android users** who want to pay but fail verification (largest group).
- **First-time UPI users**, who need more reassurance before sharing bank details.

### Options
| Option | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| Smart SIM detection and preselect | High: fixes the biggest leak | Medium |
| Explore offers before linking | Medium | Medium |
| Reminder nudges after drop-off | Low to medium | Low |

### Recommendation
Ship smart SIM detection first: detect the SIM that holds the bank-registered number, preselect it, and show a one-tap retry with the other SIM. Then test explore-before-linking against a 10% holdout. I would not lead with nudges, because reminding people to retry a step that fails does not fix it.

### How we will measure it
- **Primary:** share of new users who link a bank account within 7 days, from 35% to 45% in one quarter (assumption).
- **Supporting:** SMS verification success rate.
- **Guardrail:** fraud and failed-transaction rate on newly linked accounts must not rise.

### Trade-offs
SIM detection asks for phone-state permission; some users will refuse it, so the manual flow must stay. Explore-first might slow down users who would have linked anyway, which is why it gets a holdout rather than a full launch.

markdown:
### Improving activation
Activation is very important for any app. To improve it, PaySetu should improve the user experience and make onboarding simple and delightful. We can add gamification, rewards and cashback to motivate users. We should also use AI to personalise the experience and send notifications. Marketing campaigns on social media will also help. By doing all of these things, activation will go up and users will be happy.

items.text: How would you improve first-week bank-linking activation for PaySetu's UPI app (35% today)?

facts.text: In PaySetu's onboarding funnel, 48% of users who start bank linking drop off at the SMS verification step.

markdown:
### Diagnosis
48% of users who start bank linking drop off at SMS verification [S1]. PaySetu's competitors see 70% activation in the first week [S9], and 60% of Indian users say they do not trust new payment apps. The average user opens 4 finance apps a month.

### Recommendation
Fix SIM selection at verification, and add a trust badge on the linking screen.

### Metric
Share of new users who link a bank account within 7 days.
